title: IT Sales Executive
description:
IT Sales Executive
Salary: £30,000 basic + £5,000 commission (OTE £35,000)
Hours: Full-time
Location: Warwick / Remote office attendance approximately once a month, with travel to clients as required
We re looking for an IT Sales Executive to join a growing business within the technology sector. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who already understands the IT channel or distribution environment and is ready to take the next step into a sales-focused role.
You don t necessarily need to come from a direct sales background. What matters is that you re commercially minded, confident building relationships and excited by the opportunity to develop your career within technology sales.
You ll receive plenty of hands-on support and training while building relationships with partners, generating new opportunities and developing your knowledge of channel sales.
About the candidate
You ll be a self-motivated and proactive individual who is comfortable taking the initiative and creating new opportunities. You ll have a genuine interest in technology, along with the confidence to build strong relationships and communicate effectively with a range of stakeholders.
Ideally, you ll have some experience within IT distribution, the technology channel or a similar environment and be looking to take the next step into a sales-focused position. You ll be commercially minded, organised and comfortable working towards targets, with a proactive approach to identifying and developing new business opportunities.
You ll also be confident using CRM systems and other sales or business tools to manage opportunities and keep track of your pipeline. Previous sales experience would be beneficial but isn t essential, as training and support will be provided.
What you ll do
You ll be responsible for developing relationships with partners, identifying new business opportunities and supporting opportunities throughout the sales process.
You ll identify and approach potential partners, generate new pipeline and help develop new commercial opportunities. Building strong relationships will be a key part of the role, alongside supporting new partners and helping progress opportunities through to completion.
You ll manage your pipeline against agreed targets and KPIs, provide regular forecasts and updates, and support events and partner-focused activities designed to generate engagement and new business.
Benefit
- Predominantly remote working
- Hands-on training and development
- Opportunity to build a career within technology sales
- Exposure to partner and supplier relationship management
- Excellent opportunity to develop channel sales and business development experience

Ready to turn your IT experience into a career in sales? If you re ambitious, commercially minded and ready for your next opportunity, we d love to hear from you apply today!

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
About Rapid Access

Rapid Access Ltd manufactures and supplies access panels and riser doors from its base in Nuneaton.

Its products go into construction and architectural projects across the UK. The business is growing, and this role joins its sales team.

The package
- £14.26 an hour, 39 hours a week
- Monday to Friday, no evenings or weekends
- No telesales or construction experience needed

The role

You'll speak to architects and contractors about upcoming projects and spot where Rapid Access products fit. When there's a real opportunity, you pass a qualified lead to sales. Success is measured against weekly and monthly lead targets.

What you'll do
- Call architects, main contractors and subcontractors using the in-house database and Glenigan
- Qualify each project: what it is, when it starts, and who makes the decisions
- Log every call and keep customer records up to date in the CRM
- Hand qualified leads to the sales team and track how they progress
- Work with sales and marketing to turn leads into real opportunities
- Hit your weekly and monthly lead generation targets

What you'll need (essential)
- Confidence making outbound calls to businesses
- Basic IT skills, including updating records on a CRM or database
- Useful, not essential
- Telemarketing, telesales or customer service experience
- Knowledge of the construction industry
- Experience using Glenigan

Benefits
- Increased pay following completion of probation.
- Monthly bonus scheme following completion of probation.
- Paid lunch fortnightly and a unique birthday bonus.
- Employee Assistance Programme (EAP).
- 25 days annual leave with extra holidays after five years of service.
- Annual health assessments.
- Company pension and participation in work events.
- Christmas shutdown.

Working arrangements

Location: Nuneaton, Warwickshire Fully on-site

Contract: Permanent Full-time 39 hours a week

Hours: Monday to Thursday 8:30am 5pm, Friday 8:30am 4pm

How to apply

No tsales background? That's fine. If you're confident on the phone and want to learn a specialist industry, click apply. We'll be in touch about next steps.

title: Account Manager - IT Managed Services
company: Sterling Recruitment Solutions Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Account Manager - IT Managed Services
- Warwickshire (Hybrid 1-2 days in the office, 3-4 from home/meeting customers)
- £35,000 - £40,000 Basic + Uncapped Commission + Benefits

Looking for an Account Management role where you can genuinely grow existing clients, uncover new opportunities and significantly increase your earnings?

We're working with a well-established and growing technology solutions provider that's investing heavily in its sales team. Due to continued growth, they're looking to appoint a sales focused Account Manager to manage and develop a portfolio of existing clients while identifying new business opportunities across the IT and Managed Services market.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone with experience selling IT Managed Services, Cybersecurity, Cloud, Telecoms, Hardware or Infrastructure solutions who enjoys building long-term relationships and delivering consultative solutions.

The Role

You'll take ownership of an existing customer base, helping clients maximise their technology investment while identifying opportunities to introduce additional products and services.

Alongside managing existing relationships, you'll focus on building pipeline and working closely with SMEs to deliver tailored IT solutions.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop and grow an existing portfolio of business accounts
- Cross-sell and upsell a broad portfolio of IT, Managed Services and Cybersecurity solutions
- Build relationships with decision-makers including IT Managers, Directors and CEOs
- Generate and maintain a healthy sales pipeline through proactive account management
- Work collaboratively with technical consultants to scope and deliver customer solutions
- Consistently achieve and exceed monthly GP and revenue targets

About You

You'll be a driven sales professional who enjoys developing long-term customer relationships while identifying commercial opportunities.

You'll ideally have:
- Experience selling IT Managed Services, MSP, Cybersecurity, Cloud, Telecoms or Technology solutions
- Strong business development and account management skills
- Experience engaging senior decision-makers
- Excellent relationship-building ability
- A target-driven mindset with a passion for delivering exceptional customer service
- Experience using CRM systems to manage pipeline and forecasts

What's on Offer?
- £35,000 - £40,000 basic salary
- Uncapped commission with excellent earning potential
- Hybrid working
- Supportive, collaborative sales culture
- Opportunity to work with market-leading IT, Managed Services and Cybersecurity solutions

If you're an Account Manager looking to join a business that genuinely invests in its people and rewards success, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today for a confidential conversation.
